name: advent-of-code
title: Advent of Code
description: Read Advent of Code puzzles and count down to the next one; with your session cookie, copy inputs, submit answers and follow private leaderboards.
author: rokoov

preferences.name: session
preferences.title: Session Cookie
preferences.description: The value of the "session" cookie from adventofcode.com. Needed for your input, answers, stars and private leaderboards.

preferences.name: leaderboardId
preferences.title: Private Leaderboard ID
preferences.description: The number at the end of a private leaderboard's URL. Leave empty to choose from the leaderboards you're on.

commands.name: today
commands.title: Today's Puzzle
commands.subtitle: Advent of Code
commands.description: Read the latest unlocked puzzle, copy your input and submit answers.

commands.name: browse
commands.title: Browse Puzzles
commands.subtitle: Advent of Code
commands.description: Browse every puzzle from every year with your stars.

commands.name: leaderboard
commands.title: Private Leaderboard
commands.subtitle: Advent of Code
commands.description: See scores, stars and solve times on your private leaderboard.

commands.name: countdown
commands.title: Puzzle Countdown
commands.subtitle: Advent of Code
commands.description: Show the time until the next puzzle unlocks in the menu bar.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
